title: Incident Response Retainer Allowances — Sentinel Managed Security
content:
Every Sentinel Managed Security tier sets the incident response retainer it carries: the hours granted each contract year, the hourly rate for hours beyond the balance, how time is rounded and floored per incident, the engagement target and the share of unused hours that may roll over.

## Retainer terms

- **Annual included hours**: incident response retainer hours granted at the start of each contract year (hours).
- **Overage hourly rate**: the rate for incident response hours beyond the available balance (USD per hour).
- **Billing increment**: the increment incident response time is rounded up to (whole minutes).
- **Minimum hours per incident**: the minimum incident response hours logged per engaged incident (hours).
- **Engagement target**: the target time from the client's request to incident responder engagement (whole minutes).
- **Rollover share**: the share of the annual incident response grant that may roll into the next contract year if unused (percent of the annual included hours).

## Allowances by tier

| Sentinel tier | Annual included hours | Overage hourly rate (USD) | Billing increment (minutes) | Minimum hours per incident | Engagement target (minutes) | Rollover share (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 0 | 325.00 | 60 | 4 | 480 | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 0 | 310.00 | 60 | 4 | 240 | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 10 | 295.00 | 30 | 2 | 120 | 0 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 20 | 285.00 | 30 | 2 | 120 | 0 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 40 | 275.00 | 30 | 1 | 60 | 25 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 80 | 265.00 | 15 | 1 | 60 | 50 |

## Figures derived from the table

| Sentinel tier | Most hours that may roll into the next contract year | Engagement target in hours |
|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 0 | 8 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 0 | 4 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 0 | 2 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 0 | 2 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 10 (25 percent of 40) | 1 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 40 (50 percent of 80) | 1 |

- Sentinel EDR Essentials and Sentinel MDR Standard include no retainer hours, so on those tiers every incident response hour is beyond the available balance.
- Only Sentinel XDR Premier and Sentinel XDR Enterprise allow any rollover.
- Sentinel XDR Enterprise rounds time to the finest increment, 15 minutes.
